useCase: Verificación de la consistencia de sombras para detectar generación por IA o composición de imágenes
mechanism: Detecta sombra edges and estimates sombra direction vectors using gradiente análisis. Verifica that all sombras in the scene are consistent with a single (or known) light source configuration. AI images frequently produce sombras cast in contradictory directions or with inconsistent softness/hardness.
accuracy: Moderada - 68-78% on images with clearly visible sombras
name: Análisis de Consistencia de Sombras
source: Kee et al. (2013) - Exposing Digital Forgeries from Cast Shadows, ACM TOMM
algorithm: Shadow Edge Detection + Vanishing Point Analysis
parameters: Shadow detección: chromaticity-based segmentation, Direction estimation: Radon transform on sombra boundaries, Consistency: pairwise angular comparison, Softness: penumbra width análisis
description: Analiza sombra geometry, direction, and softness for physical plausibility. AI models struggle to maintain consistent sombra casting from a single light source.

references.title: Kee, E. et al. (2013). Exposing Digital Photo Manipulation with Inconsistent Shadows. ACM TOMM.
Zhang, W. et al. (2009). Detecting Image Splicing by Illumination Color Estimation. IWDW.

strengths:
• Physics-based approach with strong theoretical basis
• Effective for outdoor scenes with clear sombras
• Complements lighting análisis methods
• Can detect both AI and manual manipulación
limitations:
• Requires clearly visible sombra regions
• Overcast/indoor scenes with soft lighting are difficult
• Multiple light sources complicate análisis
• Transparent or translucent objects create complex sombras
